convention_rule: Four objects left to right map to P1-P4 by ID number; the single lit/active object marks the target.
basis: Round 1 both images lit the 3rd of 4 signals and P3 was revealed. Round 2: A lights the 3rd of 4 signal posts green; B has the 3rd of 4 observatory domes open with a beam. Both point to P3, which is not client-correct (P4).
